description: The licence switch (decision Q39). Every asset carries one class; one dataset makes two builds. Implemented in modules/F1-histories-of-making/atlas/tools/licence_class.py.

classes.meaning: Public domain, CC0 or 'no known copyright' as the holder states it
A national open licence: KOGL Type 1, Japan Government Standard Terms and similar
CC BY or CC BY-SA; credit required
Our own drawing, diagram, map, photograph or translation
Non-commercial licence or permission-only; hostable only with a holder's free educational grant
In copyright, ND, unclear or restricted by the holder's own rules

rules: An old date or an anonymous maker proves nothing: the licence is read per record from the holder.
Every PERMISSION-NC item records a fallback (another object, our own drawing, a living practice or a link).
No generated images of historical objects, people or places, in any class (Q32).
